Cat Cafe Quest / Combat study 01

Three small cats.
One last lantern.

Hold the doorway, untangle a crowd, and bring everyone home. A playable local squad fight built around three independent cats and a troublesome Yarn Giant.

Prototype - Squad Combat. Candidate build, not live.

Play the encounter ↓See every skillRead the evidence

Mochi / Guardian · Soot / Witch · Clover / Alchemist

Candidate runtime 1604c70
Default-off · guest only · no saves or server rewards

The opening exchange

Watch the opening, then take over.

  1. 01 / InterceptMochi rallies. The Spool Ram aims its charge at the guarded front.
  2. 02 / HoldSoot's Thread Snare catches the Button Guard and two Sock Skippers.
  3. 03 / BurstEmber Orb reaches the marked group. HP falls and burn remains.
  4. 04 / RecoverClover's Milk Flask arcs to the injured Mochi. Green numbers heal; diamonds show shields.

Start the patrol below. Click a foe or use its target button to mark it. Leave ultimates on Auto, or uncheck a cat's Auto box and use keys 1 / 2 / 3 when charged. In wave two, try marking the healer first. Switch to Yarn Giant or Training in the left rail.

Small trouble. One giant knot.

The first boss phase sweeps a marked lane and binds one cat with a separate, targetable thread. Destroy it to free the ally; use the exposed knot to burst. Adds demand attention. Phase two introduces Cross Stitch across every party row. Guarded hits and Shield Bash build stagger; repeated control meets resistance. Enrage begins at 90 seconds.

Measured simulation / 20 seeds in every row

Two squads. A reason to choose targets.

Hearthkeepers use extra health, healing and a shield after Milk Flask. Lanternbreakers trade health for speed, damage and a piercing Witch spark. Active policy marks healer → binding thread → boss; ultimates use the same auto policy in both arms.

Twenty fixed seeds per condition, deterministic headless model. A timing improvement is evidence of target-policy leverage, not evidence of human enjoyment. No human playtest has been conducted.

Review the real build in five minutes.

pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm demo

Open http://127.0.0.1:5391/?demo&squad=1. Add &squadDebug=1 in development for wave jumps, boss spawn, ultimate charge, seed and ×1/×2/×4 speed. The ordinary production build excludes these controls.

This file runs the same app, core and presenter with embedded original assets and fonts. It has a restrictive no-network policy and no persistence. An optional ?squadDebug=1 on the file URL enables local review fixtures; close/reload to discard them.

Suggested review: 1 minute patrol opening; 1 minute mark the wave-two healer; 1 minute Yarn Giant, bind and exposed knot; 1 minute compare presets/training breakdown; 1 minute inspect skill strips and evidence.

Self-review: 7.9/10 overall, 7.7/10 art. The requested 8+ quality bar is not met. The burst preset also makes the boss easier than intended.

No human playtest. Self-grading and scripted tests cannot prove retention or final art quality. This slice is a draft candidate, not merged and not deployed. No server grants, verified saves, wallet signing, Relics or real funds.
